note: The 9 example delegates. Stable ids so scripts/seed.py can run twice safely.

delegates.name: The Perfect Suit
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate with slicked-back hair, a navy power suit, perfect posture, and shoes so shiny they sparkle.

clues.means: Adjusts its tie before a big point

delegates.one_liner: Never raises its voice. Never lets a dodge slide.
catchphrases: With respect, that wasn't my question.
I'll wait for a real answer.

voice.tone: Slow, crisp, and perfectly calm, like it already knows your answer.

look.summary: Slicked-back hair, navy power suit, shiny shoes, perfect posture.

weakness.description: Softens when you're sincere and specific. A little humor throws it off.

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Interrupter
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate with a huge open mouth, a pointing finger, and a hand always raised.

clues.means: Cuts in with Points of Information

delegates.one_liner: Has a question before you finish your first sentence.

voice.tone: Fast, loud, and impatient, like it can't wait to cut in.

look.summary: Huge open mouth, pointing finger, hand always raised.

weakness.description: Runs out of steam if you calmly decline and keep going.

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Unblinking Stare
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a perfectly still delegate with huge round eyes and a tiny mouth.

clues.means: Never blinks and stares you down

delegates.one_liner: Stares in silence until you say something you regret.

voice.tone: Slow, soft, and flat, with long pauses.

look.summary: Huge round eyes, tiny mouth, perfectly still.

weakness.description: Fill the silence with one clear question. It has to answer.
how_to_beat: Don't ramble to fill the quiet

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: Professor Relativity
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a man with wild white hair, a big mustache, a tweed jacket, and chalk in his hand.

clues.means: Cuts in to add one more thing

delegates.one_liner: Turns every point into a thought experiment you didn't ask for.
catchphrases: Imagine you're on a very fast train...

voice.tone: Excited professor who just had a breakthrough; quick, warm, a little breathless.

look.summary: Wild white hair, bushy mustache, tweed jacket, chalk in hand.

weakness.description: Loses the thread when you bring it back to real people and one simple example.
how_to_beat: Ask what it means for ordinary people

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Varsity Shark
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate in a sharp blazer with a '#1' pin and a tall stack of papers.
delegates.one_liner: Fires numbers faster than you can ask where they came from.

voice.tone: Very fast and crisp, like a varsity debater on a timer.

look.summary: Sharp blazer, '#1' pin, tall stack of papers.

weakness.description: Its numbers are vague. Ask where they come from.

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Note-Taker
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate with glasses, a giant notepad, and a pen that never stops moving.

clues.means: Writes down every word you say

delegates.one_liner: Writes down everything you say and reads it back at the worst moment.

voice.tone: Soft and precise, like it is reading from its notes.

look.summary: Glasses, giant notepad, pen always moving.

weakness.description: Stay consistent and it has nothing to quote against you.
how_to_beat: Pick one position and keep it

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Procedure Stickler
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate in a bow tie holding a gavel and a thick rule book.
delegates.one_liner: Knows every rule and will remind you of all of them.
catchphrases: The delegate will refer to other delegates in the third person.
Is the delegate aware of the rules?

voice.tone: Crisp and formal, like a strict committee chair.

look.summary: Gavel, thick rule book, bow tie.

weakness.description: Knows the rules but is weak on substance. Keep pushing the real topic.

delegates.story: Example - replace with your club's real drawings.

delegates.name: The Smiling Flip
delegates.alt_text: Doodle of a delegate whose face is split down the middle: half smile, half frown.
delegates.one_liner: Compliments you, then flips the table.
catchphrases: What a lovely point, delegate. However...
I'm sure we can agree... on my terms.

voice.tone: Warm and sweet at first, then suddenly icy.

look.summary: Face split down the middle: half smile, half frown.

weakness.description: Pin it to a clear yes-or-no commitment.
how_to_beat: Ask for a yes or no
Don't trade away your main point

delegates.name: The Blank
delegates.alt_text: Dotted outline of a delegate with a question mark for a face and a blank placard.
delegates.one_liner: A blank sheet. Build the nightmare you want to beat next.
catchphrases: Who do you want me to be?

look.summary: A dotted outline with a question mark.

weakness.description: You choose. Open The Blank builder.
